scope: Bounded independent read-only source and fixture review of UI-only forecast visibility
checks: Inline price-only arms require their own current v2 source, explicit research-only inert flags, and current row/family observations.
Original reference/availability/issue/publication order and unelapsed H1 target remain required.
One valid price family remains visible independently; no averaging or synthetic combined prediction is introduced.
Combined, price-only and unavailable pair counts are disjoint; combined unavailability remains explicit.
Inline price-only label says news not included, retains joint blocker, and preserves original issue and target clocks.
Dynamic labels remain escaped; displayed in-progress moves and probabilities are not presented as scored accuracy.
Owner fixtures cover stale/future source, row/family observations, expired targets, publication clocks and unavailable joint source.
